# rootik

> Dark-first React UI toolkit for dashboards, panels and desktop clients. React 19, zero runtime dependencies besides React. Vanilla Extract authoring in `styles/*.css.ts`, static CSS with `--rk-*` custom properties in `@layer rootik`; no consumer plugin. Dark-first ("Graphite & Iris"), opt-in Rain.

The source is the reference: each entry below points at the component (read its `вЂ¦Props` interface and JSDoc there) and at a story (`src/stories/*.stories.tsx`, open in Ladle with `?story=<id>`) that shows real usage.

## Setup

```tsx
import "rootik/styles.css";
import { RootikProvider, Toaster } from "rootik";

<RootikProvider storageKey="app:appearance">
  <App />
  <Toaster />
</RootikProvider>;
```

With Tailwind v4 declare `@layer theme, base, rootik, components, utilities;` before the imports.

## Rules

- Style through tokens only (`src/tokens.css`: `--rk-accent`, `--rk-surface-1вЂ¦4`, `--rk-text/-2/-3`, `--rk-radius*`, `--rk-space`); never hard-code colors.
- Props share one vocabulary: `variant`, `size` (`sm | md | lg`), `tone` (`neutral | accent | success | warn | danger | info`), `icon: ReactNode`. Rest props go to the root element; `className` merges.
- Controlled or uncontrolled: `value`/`onChange` or `defaultValue`; open state is `open`/`onOpenChange`.
- Wrap form controls in `Field` (label, hint, error, aria wiring). Icon-only buttons need `label`; status by color needs a text label.
- Translate the kit's strings with `<RootikProvider labels>` (`src/lib/labels.tsx`); appearance via `defaults`, `extensions` or `<Scope values>`.
- Charts take plain arrays; categorical colors come from `seriesColor(i)` in fixed order; accent marks the highlighted datum.

## Hooks and utilities

- `announce` вЂ” src/lib/announce.ts:26. Speak a message to screen readers without moving focus: "Copied", "Saved", "12 results".
- `oklchToLinearRgb` вЂ” src/lib/color.ts:17. OKLCH → linear sRGB (Björn Ottosson's OKLab matrices); values outside 0–1 are out of gamut.
- `rgbToOklch` вЂ” src/lib/color.ts:31. sRGB channels 0–1 → OKLCH (hue 0 for greys).
- `inSrgbGamut` вЂ” src/lib/color.ts:44
- `oklchToHex` вЂ” src/lib/color.ts:49. #rrggbb (gamut-clipped).
- `formatOklch` вЂ” src/lib/color.ts:60. `oklch(0.57 0.2 277)`, with ` / 0.5` when translucent.
- `parseColor` вЂ” src/lib/color.ts:77. Parse `oklch(…)`, `#rgb[a]`, `#rrggbb[aa]` or `rgb[a](…)`; null when it isn't one of those.
- `cx` вЂ” src/lib/cx.ts:1
- `useField` вЂ” src/lib/field-context.tsx:16. Wires a control to the surrounding <Field>: id for the label, hint/error for aria-describedby.
- `useFieldLabel` вЂ” src/lib/field-context.tsx:32. The surrounding Field's label id: group controls pass it as aria-labelledby.
- `floatingViewport` вЂ” src/lib/floating.tsx:22. Fixed layers must fit the visible viewport, including zoom and the on-screen keyboard.
- `clampFloatingPosition` вЂ” src/lib/floating.tsx:31
- `computePosition` вЂ” src/lib/floating.tsx:44
- `formatNumber` вЂ” src/lib/format.ts:34. Plain or compact ("1.2K") number; the compact suffix goes to `unit`.
- `formatBytes` вЂ” src/lib/format.ts:71. File sizes and traffic.
- `formatBitrate` вЂ” src/lib/format.ts:80. Network speed in bits per second: "940 Mbps".
- `formatPercent` вЂ” src/lib/format.ts:86. Ratio 0..1 as a percentage: 0.425 → "42.5%".
- `formatDuration` вЂ” src/lib/format.ts:104. Durations in milliseconds.
- `findRanges` вЂ” src/lib/highlight.tsx:18. Ranges of every query word (case-insensitive) in the text under `root`, optionally only inside `selector`.
- `useHighlight` вЂ” src/lib/highlight.tsx:42. Marks matches of `query` under `ref` with the CSS Custom Highlight API: no DOM wrapping, so React's tree and text selection stay intact.
- `useControllable` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:15. Controlled when `value` is defined, otherwise keeps its own state.
- `mergeRefs` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:32
- `cloneTrigger` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:58. Clone a trigger element, chaining its own handlers and ref with ours.
- `useLatest` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:91. Latest value in a ref: for callbacks used inside long-lived listeners.
- `readStorage` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:100. Persist a value in localStorage; storage failures (private mode, quota) are ignored.
- `writeStorage` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:110
- `isTypingTarget` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:122. The event target takes typed text: plain-key shortcuts must not steal its keystrokes.
- `useHotkeys` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:149. Every mounted `useHotkey` that has a description, in registration order.
- `useHotkey` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:161. Global shortcut ("mod+k", "shift+?"; `mod` = Ctrl or ⌘).
- `useClipboard` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:205. Copy text to the clipboard.
- `useMediaQuery` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:225. Live media query match: `useMediaQuery("(max-width: 640px)")`.
- `useElementSize` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:240. Content-box size of an element: `const { ref, width, height } = useElementSize()`.
- `useInterval` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:259. Run `callback` every `ms` (null stops).
- `usePersistentState` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:291. useState persisted in localStorage (JSON).
- `useWindowFocus` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:329. Whether the app window has focus (native apps dim their chrome and selection when it doesn't).
- `useScrollSpy` вЂ” src/lib/hooks.ts:349. Id of the section currently being read: the last one whose top has passed `offset` px below the top of `root` (the viewport by default).
- `useIndicator` вЂ” src/lib/indicator.ts:12. Measures the element matching `selector` inside `container` for a sliding selection indicator.
- `useFocusRecovery` вЂ” src/lib/roving.ts:21. Restore focus after a focused roving item is removed or natively disabled, without stealing it.
- `useRovingFocus` вЂ” src/lib/roving.ts:75. Roving tab stop for a composite widget (APG toolbar): one Tab stop for the group, arrows move between items, Home/End jump to the ends, and the last focused item is remembered.
- `nextSelection` вЂ” src/lib/selection.ts:18. Next selection after activating `key` (pure; `useSelection` wires it to state).
- `useSelection` вЂ” src/lib/selection.ts:55. Selection state for lists, tables, trees and grids: single or multiple, Shift ranges, Ctrl/⌘ toggles, select all.
- `svgPadding` вЂ” src/lib/svg-geometry.ts:38. The same normalized padding drives HTML layout and the contour's deformation budget.
- `svgGeometry` вЂ” src/lib/svg-geometry.ts:45. Every curve is contained outside the protected HTML content rectangle.
- `svgControlGeometry` вЂ” src/lib/svg-geometry.ts:50. Compact contours stay inside the controls' existing padding, without scaling stroke widths.
- `prefixOffsets` вЂ” src/lib/virtual.ts:11. Start offsets for per-index sizes (prefix sums); `offsets[count]` is the total size.
- `virtualRange` вЂ” src/lib/virtual.ts:22. Indices intersecting [offset, offset + height] plus `overscan` on each side.
- `useVirtual` вЂ” src/lib/virtual.ts:68. Windowing for long lists, tables and logs: renders only the rows in view.
